## `neuro.int8Array.entries`

Instance method on `Int8Array.prototype`.

> Returns an array of key, value pairs for every entry in the array

## Signatures

```ts
entries(input: { int8Array: <receiver>; prompt?: string }): Promise<ArrayIterator<[number, number]>>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `Int8Array.prototype.entries` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
